generation.scope: All twenty distinguished singular points of the general projective quartic center are ordinary double points. The two simple dimensions there are 4 and 12. The completed order on the projective chart is End(R^4 + I^12) for the conifold R and the rank-one cokernel of its two-by-two matrix.

proof_review.scope: Checked integral norm transfer, the reduced eigenvalue bound, trace multiplicities of primitive idempotents, reflexive Morita recovery, and the local trace ideal calculation forcing a node.

mathematical_computation.scope: Over 2657 all twenty central roots have multiplicity 2, and the regular action of a fixed quartic loop pencils off an eigenvalue of multiplicity 8. The reduced characteristic polynomial has a simple eigenvalue.

tex.engine: LuaHBTeX; no overfull boxes, missing glyphs or undefined references

open_mathematics: Test whether the twenty ordinary nodes exhaust the isolated singular points or whether other curves or points carry degree-two corner simples. Make the bounded central-finite AS criterion effective outside the proven regular open.
